title: 2024 Chinese Zodiac: Year of the Wood Dragon
seo_title: 2024 Chinese Zodiac: Year of the Wood Dragon (10 February – 28 January 2025)
description: 2024 is the Year of the Wood Dragon (Yang, Jia-chen), from 10 February 2024 to 28 January 2025. Personality, lucky colors and numbers, best matches, and what to know if you were born in January or February 2024.
lead: Born in 2024? Your Chinese zodiac animal is most likely the Dragon, but check the date: the 2024 Wood Dragon year began on 10 February 2024. Here is everything about the year, from its element to its lucky colors and best matches.
card_text: 2024: Year of the Wood Dragon, from 10 February 2024 to 28 January 2025.

image.alt: Golden Dragon of the Chinese zodiac in front of a moonlit temple
image.caption: Illustration from MyBirthSign's zodiac artwork; it is not a photograph.

paras: The Chinese zodiac year 2024 was the Year of the Dragon. It began with Lunar New Year on 10 February 2024 and ended on 28 January 2025, the eve of the next Lunar New Year.

Each year also has an element and a Yin or Yang quality. 2024 ends in 4, which makes it a Wood year, and as an even year it is Yang. In the traditional stem-and-branch count, 2024 is a Jia-chen year. The same Wood Dragon combination comes round only once every 60 years: 1964 before it and 2084 after it.
Lunar New Year 2024 fell on 10 February 2024, so everyone born in January 2024, and in February before that date, belongs to the previous year's animal, the Rabbit.

The zodiac year starts at Lunar New Year, not on 1 January, which is why early-year birthdays need checking. Our guide Born in January? explains the rule, and the zodiac sign checker gives the exact answer for any birth date.

Our Dragon guide describes the sign like this: “Confident, charismatic, and ambitious. Dragons draw attention and often rise to leadership naturally.” The usual watch-out: “Can come across as proud or impatient with limitations.”

The Wood element adds its own flavour. Wood years bring growth, creativity, and a drive to build new things. People of this element tend to be cooperative, generous, and idealistic. Read more in our Wood element guide, or the full Year of the Dragon page.
Careers often linked with the Dragon: leadership, entrepreneurship, entertainment, real estate.

sections.h2: Best matches for someone born in 2024
paras: In traditional compatibility, the Dragon's best matches are the Rat, Monkey and Rooster, and its clash sign is the Dog, which sits directly opposite it on the zodiac circle. Our compatibility calculator compares two full birth dates, elements included.
2026 (Fire Horse, until 5 February 2027): for the Dragon, it has no special traditional relationship with the Horse, so 2026 is a neutral year.
2027 (Fire Goat, from 6 February 2027): for the Dragon, it has no special traditional relationship with the Goat, so 2027 is a neutral year. See Chinese zodiac 2027 predictions for every sign.

sections.h2: Other Year of the Dragon years
paras: Years of the same animal come every twelve years, each with a different element: 2000 (Metal Dragon); 2012 (Water Dragon); 2036 (Fire Dragon). The full list is in our Chinese zodiac years chart.

faq: 2024 is the Year of the Dragon, a Yang Wood Dragon year (Jia-chen).
When does the 2024 Year of the Dragon start and end?
It starts on 10 February 2024 and ends on 28 January 2025.
I was born in January 2024. What is my Chinese zodiac?
A Rabbit: Lunar New Year 2024 was on 10 February 2024, so all of January 2024 belongs to the Rabbit year.
Wood. 2024 ends in 4, which belongs to Wood, and it is a Yang year.
Who is the Dragon compatible with?
Traditionally the Rat, Monkey and Rooster. The Dragon's clash sign is the Dog.
